preconditions.description: The length n of the string t is an integer between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: isinstance(t, str) and len(t) == n and all(c in '01' for c in t)
preconditions.description: The string t has length n and consists only of characters '0' and '1'.
The number of queries q is an integer between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(l1, int) and isinstance(l2, int) and isinstance(length, int) and 1 <= l1 <= n and 1 <= l2 <= n and 1 <= length <= n - max(l1, l2) + 1 for l1, l2, length in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query consists of three integers l1, l2, and length satisfying the bounds 1 <= l1, l2 <= n and 1 <= length <= n - max(l1, l2) + 1.

postconditions.expression: len(output_lines) == q and all(line in ('YES', 'Yes', 'yes', 'NO', 'No', 'no') for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: The output consists of exactly q lines, each being a case-insensitive 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all((output_lines[i].upper() == 'YES') == (is_reachable(t, queries[i][0], queries[i][1], queries[i][2])) for i in range(q))
postconditions.description: For each query i, the output is 'YES' if and only if the substring starting at l1 with length len is reachable from the substring starting at l2 with the same length, where reachability is defined by the operations replacing '011' with '110' or '110' with '011'.
